• Ticket Manipulation: The only way to contact them is the app, but they keep cancelling/closing my service requests without any resolution. They simply cancel the ticket to avoid accountability.

• Lack of Access: There is absolutely no way to contact them easily. They have built a system specifically to hide from customers once they have collected the money.

• Unprofessional Staff: On the rare occasion I managed to connect with a representative, they were incredibly rude, arrogant, and dismissive of the fact that their product is causing harm. A Furlenco representative named Abrar finally came to inspect the product, but instead of fixing it, he damaged one of the chairs even further. Summary: Furlenco is happy to take your monthly rent but provides zero support when they deliver faulty, dangerous goods. I am now escalating this to the National Consumer Helpline.
